description: List tests discovered by the connected project's official Unity Test Framework. Use this instead of scanning assemblies or reflecting over NUnit attributes. After writing or hot-reloading C# tests, call unity_recompile before listing; the new test tree becomes available after compilation and domain reload complete. The tool is present only when Unity Test tools are enabled for the workspace and com.unity.test-framework is installed. Filters within one field are ORed; different fields are combined. Exact test names use the full Unity Test Framework name, including parameter values.

groups.description: Optional regular expressions matching full test names, fixtures, or namespaces.

max_results.description: Maximum returned test cases, capped at 5000. The response reports the full matched count and whether it was truncated.
